name: rollout-plan
description: One of four release-engineering phase-2 norm plugins: pre-declared per-step, per-metric rollout thresholds. A rollout step may not be marked result: pass or result: fail with an unset threshold — rollout-plan-fields-gate.sh refuses the write; result: pending is never gated. Ships the rollout-plan skill.

dependencies.note: Requires the core plugin from tokenmaxxxer-core installed alongside this plugin. Composes with readiness-checklist, error-budget-policy, and postmortem to form the release-engineering phase-2 norm.
